title: Fixed Chain Band Footboard and Beater Drum Pedal
description: One newly authored complete empty bass-drum-pedal-style static mechanism exterior. One long ground plate carries a rear heel hinge, full sloping footboard, two front bearing towers and a transverse shaft with a fixed circular cam. A continuous narrow thick drive band rises from the footboard front and wraps over the cam, with separated small transverse raised link-like ribs. An independent long beater stem and thick cylindrical head rise from the shaft; an outboard crank and continuous helical return-spring appearance connect to a lower rooted anchor. A front fixed open clamp-like seat finishes the whole empty unit. The existing complete drum kit explicitly contains no pedal and no component is extracted from it; this is not the large grindstone frame reduced in scale, since it has no stone or long rigid crank rod and uses a compact shaft/beater/band/spring organization. All numeric geometry newly authored. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Fixed empty appearance only: no drum supplied, mounting fit, pedal travel, working chain, elastic spring response, striking, force, sound, tuning, ergonomics, load, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
